name: p3-sticky-delete
notes: P3 (corrupt-events): a STICKY swap piston also deletes. Sticky piston up on the bedrock (a second bedrock under the target makes the two-ahead cell unpullable), torch beside it. Chord: break torch (queues a type-1 retract), break the sticky piston, place a sticky piston facing down. At execution the sticky branch finds the two-ahead bedrock not pushable and removeBlocks the front cell (PistonBaseBlock 192-199): the target bedrock is deleted.
